speaker: Unknown
en: Hey, I'm Ali, co-founder of Circleback.
zh: 嘿，我是 Ali，Circleback 的联合创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were in the YC Winter 24 batch and excited to show you my setup.
zh: 我们是 YC 24 冬季批次的成员，很高兴向你展示我的装备。

speaker: Unknown
en: Circleback is an AI note taker that captures and organizes everything from your conversations.
zh: Circleback 是一款 AI 笔记工具，可以捕捉并整理你对话中的所有内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: It records and transcribes your meetings, writes the notes, and assigns the action items.
zh: 它会录制并转写你的会议，撰写笔记，并分配行动项。

speaker: Unknown
en: It also lets you build automations to pull custom info from those meetings and update other apps that you use like your CRM, your issue tracker, your Slack.
zh: 它还让你能构建自动化流程，从这些会议中提取自定义信息，并更新你使用的其他应用，比如你的 CRM、你的问题跟踪器、你的 Slack。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can also ask it questions across all of your team's conversations, connect your agents to it, and essentially use it as your company brain that remembers everything.
zh: 你还可以跨团队的所有对话向它提问，把你的智能体连接上去，基本上把它当作你公司的记忆大脑来用，它能记住一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take me through your hardware setup.
zh: 带我看看你的硬件装备吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the things that you cannot live without?
zh: 有哪些东西是你离不开的？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I try to have a pretty minimal setup, both in terms of like tools and software that I use and things on my desk.
zh: 我尽量保持相当精简的配置，无论是我使用的工具和软件，还是我桌上的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I still am a big fan of mechanical keyboards.
zh: 我仍然是机械键盘的忠实粉丝。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I kind of kept going down the rabbit hole of what's the most elite keyboard.
zh: 而且我一度陷入了“什么才是最顶级键盘”的兔子洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this was actually not a mechanical keyboard.
zh: 而这个其实不是机械键盘。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a membrane keyboard.
zh: 它是一张薄膜键盘。

speaker: Unknown
en: This style of keyboard is called Topre, which I think is...
zh: 这种风格的键盘叫 Topre，我觉得它是……

speaker: Unknown
en: For Tokyo Precision, first off, it was really hard to get.
zh: Tokyo Precision 的缩写，首先，它真的很难买到。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when I received it in the mail, all the instruction manuals for it were in Japanese.
zh: 当我用邮件收到它时，所有的说明书都是日文的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there's still a lot of things that I'm sure I can do with it that I don't know about.
zh: 所以肯定还有很多它能做的事我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's quite nice to type on because it's got a very nice typing feel, but it's also not super loud.
zh: 但打字手感非常好，因为它有很棒的敲击感，而且也不算特别吵。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it has a very like early registration of each key press so you don't need to like bottom out every key.
zh: 而且每个按键的触发非常靠前，所以你不需要每次都把按键按到底。

speaker: Unknown
en: I also do love like blue and brown switches of mechanical keyboards but they're a little louder and obnoxious in like an open office which is what we have.
zh: 我也确实喜欢机械键盘的青轴和茶轴，但它们在开放式办公室里有点太吵、太烦人了，而我们的办公室正是开放式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you share more about the little vehicle that is on your desk?
zh: 能分享一下你桌上那个小车吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So this little guy is when we're doing our onboarding, we're all kind of like obsessed with how different products do their onboarding.
zh: 这个小家伙是这样的：我们在做用户引导（onboarding）时，大家都对不同产品怎么做引导很着迷。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got served an ad for Teemu for this and I got hypnotized like all the way through the onboarding process.
zh: 我被 Teemu 投放的一个广告推荐了这个东西，然后在整个引导流程中我被完全催眠了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I actually ended up with like six things in my cart with $400 of like cash back with Teemu.
zh: 我最后购物车里多了六样东西，还有 400 美元的 Teemu 返现。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was about to actually press check out because they make it so easy.
zh: 我当时差点真的按下结账，因为它们把流程做得太简单了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like there's the right amount of dopamine injection at every level.
zh: 每个环节都注入了恰到好处的多巴胺。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I ended up like waking up to like what was going on and removed everything but kept this guy.
zh: 但我最后清醒过来，意识到发生了什么，把所有东西都删了，只留下了这个小家伙。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now it's something that I like when we're like talking about something I like play with while while we're like discussing something or if I'm like dictating something and like at the same time just something to fidget with.
zh: 现在它成了我喜欢的东西，当我们讨论某件事时我会一边玩它，或者当我在口述什么东西时，同时就是拿来捏着玩的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I also have the AirPods Max.
zh: 我还有 AirPods Max。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've had these forever.
zh: 我用它们很久了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's honestly more of like a status, not in terms of like signaling to the rest of the team that like you're locked in.
zh: 说实话它更多是一种身份信号，不是向团队其他人示意你很专注那种。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't wear them often when I do.
zh: 我不常戴，但戴的时候就意味着那个信号。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's kind of what it signals.
zh: 基本上它传达的就是这个意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's kind of like if you were on MSN or AIM and like you're setting your status as locked in.
zh: 就好像你在 MSN 或 AIM 上把状态设成“专注中”一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you share some unexpected ways you are using Circleback?
zh: 能分享一些你使用 Circleback 的意想不到的方式吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, so I kind of use it as my ATS.
zh: 好的，我基本上把它当作我的 ATS 来用。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have this view for meetings and action items where I can kind of keep on top of everything that we need to do.
zh: 我有一个会议和行动项的视图，可以让我掌握所有我们需要做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this view is basically any action item that belongs to someone at Circleback that is not done and is from an interview.
zh: 这个视图基本上是所有属于 Circleback 成员、尚未完成、并且来自面试的行动项。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I can kind of use these to keep track of, okay, who are the people that we need to get back to and who is being interviewed by who at the company.
zh: 这样我可以用这些来跟踪：好，哪些人我们需要回复，谁正在被公司里的谁面试。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then sometimes when I'm really excited about a candidate I will actually go to their person page to get a full timeline of the touch points that they've had with the rest of the team whether it's emails or meetings and then also make sure that like they have an upcoming interview booked or if they already had their previous interview go and look and see like how did it go
zh: 然后有时候当我对某个候选人特别感兴趣时，我会真的去他们的个人页面，查看他们与团队其他成员接触的完整时间线，无论是邮件还是会议，然后还要确认他们是否已经预约了接下来的面试，或者如果他们已经完成了上一轮面试，就去看看面试进行得怎么样

speaker: Unknown
en: And how they performed on it.
zh: 以及他们在其中的表现如何。

speaker: Unknown
en: And generally, I also use Circleback to kind of keep track of people and companies that we're talking to.
zh: 另外，我通常也用 Circleback 来跟踪我们正在接触的人和公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, for example, with the Y Combinator company page in Circleback, I can see who are all the people that we've talked to at YC.
zh: 举例来说，通过 Circleback 里的 Y Combinator 公司页面，我可以看到我们在 YC 接触过的所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there anything that we owe them in terms of like our action items?
zh: 我们有没有欠他们什么行动项？

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the things that they're doing?
zh: 他们正在做什么事情？

speaker: Unknown
en: And like a full timeline of conversations that we've had with anyone from YC.
zh: 还有我们与 YC 任何人对话的完整时间线。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also like upcoming meetings so I can see this shoot is there.
zh: 还包括即将到来的会议，这样我就能看到，糟糕，这个在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also have our post-batch group office hours tomorrow.
zh: 我们明天还有批次后的集体 office hours。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just a unified view of everything that's going on.
zh: 就是一个把所有正在进行的事情统一在一起的视图。

speaker: Unknown
en: One thing that I was doing literally last night in preparation for this interview was I asked Circleback to prep me for this.
zh: 昨晚我在为这次采访做准备时，实际上做的一件事就是让 Circleback 帮我备战这次采访。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it went through all the emails that we've exchanged, past conversations that you and I have had to get a full understanding of like, what is this going to be?
zh: 它把我们之间往来的所有邮件、过往对话都过了一遍，来完全理解，比如说，这会是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it gave me this prep that, you know, site sources from my calendar of like, where is this going to be?
zh: 然后它给了我这份准备材料，你知道的，从我的日历里引用来源，比如说，这会在哪里举行？

speaker: Unknown
en: Emails that you had sent of like potential things to prepare for.
zh: 你发过的邮件里，比如说有哪些潜在需要准备的事项。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then also went through my past meetings of like cool things to showcase, given the understanding that I had of the questions that were shared.
zh: 然后它还翻了我过往的会议记录，比如有哪些可以展示的酷东西，基于我对被分享的问题的理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one thing that I use multiple times a day is just pressing and holding the action button.
zh: 我每天会多次使用的一个功能，就是长按操作按钮。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have it set to start a recording on Circleback.
zh: 我把它设置为在 Circleback 上开始录音。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's super helpful if I just want to quickly capture something.
zh: 如果我只是想快速记录点东西，这超级有用。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't have to fiddle with my phone.
zh: 我不用去摆弄手机。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just press this one button.
zh: 我只需按这一个按钮。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're also releasing a watch app, which will make it so you just press the complication on your watch and it starts a new recording.
zh: 我们也在发布一个手表应用，这样你只需按下手表上的复杂功能，它就会开始新的录音。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's also super helpful for me.
zh: 这对我也非常有帮助。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I don't have my phone because I'm like walking around the office and it's at my desk or I'm on a walk and I don't want to be holding my phone the whole time, that's something that I've been using a lot as we've been beta testing it.
zh: 当我没带手机时，比如我在办公室里走动而手机在办公桌上，或者我在散步而不想一直拿着手机，这是我们 beta 测试期间我一直用得很多的功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: How much of your day do you spend in OpenClaw, Telegram versus coding tools?
zh: 你一天中有多少时间花在 OpenClaw、Telegram 上，而不是编程工具上？

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably...
zh: 大概……

speaker: Unknown
en: Like 10, 20% with OpenClaw because a lot of things is just always on and it's just working.
zh: 像 10%、20% 用在 OpenClaw 上，因为很多东西就是一直开着，它一直在工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the state ideally I want them to be in.
zh: 那是我理想中希望它们所处的状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then with coding tools, I would say more of my time.
zh: 然后编程工具的话，我会在那上面花更多时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been spending a lot of my time reviewing code recently, so not writing as much or putting up as many PRs.
zh: 我最近花了很多时间在审查代码上，所以没有写那么多代码，也没有提交那么多 PR。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you share more about the different agents that you created in Telegram?
zh: 你能多分享一下你在 Telegram 上创建的不同智能体吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, so I have my like main claw agent and then I have one for finance, one for customers, one for people ops.
zh: 好的，我有一个主要的 claw 智能体，然后还有一个管财务的、一个管客户的、一个管人力运营的。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are just like boring names I came up with because I couldn't think of something more creative when I made them.
zh: 这些只是我随手起的很无聊的名字，因为创建它们的时候想不出更有创意的名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're also in the middle of moving all of these processes that currently live in my open claw to actual Slack channels at the company.
zh: 我们还正在把这些目前存在于我的 open claw 里的流程，全部迁移到公司的实际 Slack 频道里。

speaker: Unknown
en: So anytime we get a customer email, there's like a new thread on Slack with the investigation and you can kind of do the whole back and forth there.
zh: 所以每次我们收到客户邮件，Slack 上就会有一个新线程，包含调查过程，你可以在那里完成整个来回沟通。

speaker: Unknown
en: Same with inbound sales.
zh: 销售线索也是一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's good because it makes it a company effort and also gives everyone visibility of like, what are the things that our customers are reaching out to us about or what types of customers are reaching out for sales and like, what do they care about?
zh: 这很好，因为它让这成为全公司的努力，也让所有人都能看到，比如说，客户都在向我们咨询些什么，或者什么类型的客户在咨询销售，以及，他们关心什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And if it doesn't pan out, like, why is that the case?
zh: 而如果最后没成，比如，为什么会是那样？

speaker: Unknown
en: We have, I would say, a lot of
zh: 我们有，可以说，很多

speaker: Unknown
en: More traditional businesses that like sit in cubicles and we're the only non-Microsoft product they use.
zh: 更传统的企业，坐在格子间里的那种，我们是他们使用的唯一非 Microsoft 产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we have a lot of growth stage startups and YC companies that also use our product.
zh: 然后我们也有很多成长期初创公司和 YC 公司在使用我们的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's also one of the reasons we continue to do a weekly run rotation where an engineer is handling all the incoming support and talks to our customers.
zh: 所以这也是我们持续实行每周值班轮换的原因之一，由一名工程师处理所有进来的支持请求并与客户交流。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is, for example, a fireside chat that we had with a customer in June.
zh: 比如，这是我们在六月与一位客户进行的炉边谈话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can see quickly like what were the things that we talked about.
zh: 我可以快速看到，我们都谈了些什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's also super helpful because when they share feedback while they're at our office, Circleback captures it and these were some things that we were going to look into for them.
zh: 这也非常有用，因为当他们来我们办公室分享反馈时，Circleback 会记录下来，这些是我们当时准备为他们调查的一些事项。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I can actually go back and look at the recording of the meeting that we imported into Circleback from here and jump to a specific part.
zh: 然后我实际上可以回去查看我们从这里导入到 Circleback 的会议录音，并跳转到特定部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can also ask a question here.
zh: 我还可以在这里提问。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was on Chris's wish list for Circleback?
zh: Chris 对 Circleback 的愿望清单上有什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it'll comb through everything that we talked about in the 30 minutes and give us a quick rundown.
zh: 然后它会翻遍我们在这 30 分钟里谈的所有内容，给我们一个快速的摘要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I can also follow up with making sure like, hey, have we done any of these?
zh: 然后我还可以跟进确认一下，比如，嘿，这些我们做了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: If so, let's draft an email and send it to him that we ship these things.
zh: 如果是这样的话,让我们起草一封邮件发给他,说我们把这些东西发布出去了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What percentage of your day do you spend in a terminal versus everything else?
zh: 你一天中有多少时间花在终端里，而不是其他所有事情上？

speaker: Unknown
en: I love writing code and like building the product so as much as I can, but recently I've been like consciously weeding myself off of it because the bottlenecks of the company, we have a lot of great engineers on the team now and like our bottleneck is bringing on more great people to increase our throughput of like product decisions and everything else with the company as well.
zh: 我热爱写代码，喜欢构建产品，所以能写多少就写多少，但最近我一直在有意识地让自己戒掉这件事，因为公司的瓶颈——我们团队现在有很多优秀的工程师，而我们的瓶颈是引入更多优秀的人才，以提高我们在产品决策以及公司其他所有事情上的吞吐量。

speaker: Unknown
en: But Thursdays is my no meeting day which I look forward to every week and those are the days where I like just go like headphones on and work on a lot of things that's been on my mind and try to like end-to-end actually ship the thing within that day whatever it is that I'm working on.
zh: 但每周四是我的无会议日，我每周都盼着这一天，那些日子我就戴上耳机，处理很多一直在我心里的事，并且尽量在那天之内端到端地真正把那个东西上线，不管我在做的是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what are the tools that you're using on a day-to-day basis to write code?
zh: 那你日常写代码都使用哪些工具？

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like writing a lot of code myself even like through Christmas and then I started using Claude Code again around that time.
zh: 我之前自己写了大量代码，甚至一直到圣诞节前后，然后在大约那个时候我开始重新使用 Claude Code。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think a lot of people went through this around then and now I'm at a point where I mostly use like an orchestrating agent orchestrator to
zh: 我想当时很多人都经历过类似的过程，现在我处于一个阶段，主要使用一个编排型智能体调度器来

speaker: Unknown
en: Fire off a couple of things and then revisit and review them.
zh: 发出几个任务，然后回头审查它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: For some things, I still manually edit code.
zh: 对于某些事情，我仍然手动编辑代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: For copy, I like to be able to quickly change it and see how it looks in context on the product.
zh: 比如文案，我喜欢能快速修改它，并在产品上下文里看它呈现的效果。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or for small styling things, if we're playing around with some things, it's just quicker to edit the file directly yourself.
zh: 或者一些小的样式调整，如果我们在尝试一些东西，直接自己编辑文件会更快。

speaker: Unknown
en: But for most other things, we've built enough scaffolding and infrastructure that AI agents are really good at doing things end-to-end.
zh: 但对于大多数其他事情，我们已经构建了足够的脚手架和基础设施，AI 智能体在端到端完成事情方面非常出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the bottleneck then becomes code review which we've also done a lot to kind of spawn different types of agents depending on what the PR is and making sure that everything not just from like a code quality standpoint but also architecture and like product and even like the copy of what we're putting in goes through that AI review that makes sure everything is consistent with how we usually do things.
zh: 然后瓶颈就变成了代码审查，我们也为此做了很多工作，根据 PR 的类型生成不同类型的智能体，确保所有内容——不仅是代码质量层面，还包括架构、产品，甚至我们写入的文案——都经过 AI 审查，确保一切都与我们通常的做事方式保持一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: Walk us through how you write and test props.
zh: 请带我们了解一下你是如何编写和测试 props 的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have evals in place for things where it's quantifiable or there's a right or wrong answer, like what things should come up as action items.
zh: 对于可量化的或有对错答案的事情，我们有评估（evals），比如哪些内容应该被列为行动项。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like if I say during a meeting, hey, I'm going to send you this right now, and there's a signal that like the thing was done during the meeting.
zh: 比如我在会议期间说，嘿，我现在就把这个发给你，而且有信号表明这件事在会议期间就已完成。

speaker: Unknown
en: That should not be an action item.
zh: 那它就不应该成为行动项。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's already done.
zh: 它已经完成了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It would be redundant.
zh: 再列出来就多余了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's unnecessary noise.
zh: 那是不必要的噪音。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other things that we've really tried to do is the writing style, actually getting struggle back notes to seem like they're written by a person.
zh: 我们真正努力去做的其他事情是写作风格，让 struggle back 笔记看起来真的像是一个人写的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also we're kind of opinionated in like what good looks like as we should be.
zh: 而且我们对「什么是好的」相当有自己的主张，这也是我们应该的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's a it's one of the primary surface areas of the product.
zh: 我认为这是产品最核心的表面区域之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: But for example, like we really try to never have our notes say the word discussed because it's
zh: 但举个例子，我们真的尽量不让我们的笔记里出现「discussed（讨论了）」这个词，因为

speaker: Unknown
en: Fully pointless.
zh: 它完全没有意义。

speaker: Unknown
en: Obviously, things were discussed.
zh: 显然，事情都被讨论过了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a meeting.
zh: 这是一场会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't add any value.
zh: 它不增加任何价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's, I think, somewhere in our evals as well when we, like, update models or change prompts to see how is it faring with every incremental change that we make.
zh: 所以我认为这也在我们的评估里，当我们更新模型或更改提示词时，看看我们做的每一次增量改动效果如何。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if you don't have good systems in place to make incremental improvements, you're constantly playing this game of whack-a-mole.
zh: 因为如果你没有好的系统来做增量改进，你就会一直玩打地鼠的游戏。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, maybe we made the overview of the notes better, but now the topics are too long or things like that.
zh: 比如，也许我们把笔记的概览做得更好了，但现在主题部分又太长了，诸如此类。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are your thoughts on token maxing?
zh: 你对 token maxing 有什么看法？

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a big culture of not just doing the thing, like the task at hand, but also doing it in a way that makes it so the next time you or someone else goes to do that same thing, it's easier or the output is better.
zh: 我们有一种浓厚的文化，不只是完成手头的任务，还要以一种方式去完成它，使得下一次你或其他人在做同样的事情时更容易，或产出更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in that way, a big part of it is using AI extensively for the things that we do, automating a lot of ops tasks that like no one should be doing.
zh: 所以从这个角度说，很重要的一部分是广泛地用 AI 来做我们做的事情，自动化很多没人应该去做的运营任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right now we have an unlimited budget for like using AI and we trust the judgment of everyone on the team.
zh: 现在我们使用 AI 的预算是不设上限的，我们信任团队里每个人的判断。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe that doesn't scale when we're like 10x the size, but right now we just care about using the best tools to produce the highest quality output.
zh: 也许等我们规模扩大 10 倍时这就不适用了，但现在我们只在乎用最好的工具产出最高质量的成果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we also like during our show and tells are constantly like showing each other like, hey, this is a cool tool that I started using this week and here's how I'm using it.
zh: 而且在我们的 show and tell 环节，我们也经常互相展示，比如，嘿，这是我这周开始用的一款很酷的工具，这是我怎么用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's different about your flow today versus six months ago?
zh: 你今天的流程和六个月前相比有什么不同？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think I'm not really in the editor much anymore.
zh: 我觉得我已经不怎么待在编辑器里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like I use a very lightweight, I use Zed right now as my editor, just to go in and like review diffs really quickly or make small changes.
zh: 我现在用一个很轻量的编辑器，用 Zed，只是进去快速审查 diff 或做一些小的修改。

speaker: Unknown
en: But most of my work is like directly through agents when writing code.
zh: 但我大部分写代码的工作都是直接通过智能体完成的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think I'm doing a lot less of the things that I didn't like as part of being a founder, which is the ops-related work where I was like, I don't need to be logging into our payroll software to be doing this.
zh: 我觉得自己少做了很多作为创始人不喜欢的那些事情，也就是运营相关的工作，我以前会想，我不需要为了这种事登录我们的工资软件。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a lot of those things I've automated.
zh: 所以我把其中很多都自动化了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just in terms of being able to do more of the things that I'm most high leverage at and really good at, I'm doing more of that now than I was six months ago because I'm not constantly underwater from all the miscellaneous things that surround running a company.
zh: 单就能够做更多我最能发挥杠杆作用、最擅长的事情而言，我现在做的比六个月前多了，因为我不再一直被经营公司周围那些琐事压得喘不过气。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the things that you do not let agents do?
zh: 有哪些事情是你不让智能体做的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Never send an email on its own of draft is okay.
zh: 绝不自主发送邮件，草稿是可以的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think copying the product, generally, like we want to make sure it's super clear.
zh: 还有产品文案，总的来说，我们要确保它非常清晰。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can take a first pass, but never something that goes into production.
zh: 它可以先出一稿，但绝不能是直接进入生产环境的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then anything with data access and security, it's good for reviewing and doing, like that's one of our sub-agents that does a pass, but we basically don't want to let the agent architect the thing, but like the engineer or whoever's working on it should architect it and then have
zh: 然后是任何涉及数据访问和安全的事情，它适合用来审查和做类似的工作，那是我们的一个子智能体负责做一遍检查，但我们基本不想让智能体去做架构设计，而是应该由工程师或负责的人来做架构，然后再让

speaker: Unknown
en: The AI agent actually built it out.
zh: AI 智能体真正把它构建出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you share more about the thesis around companies needing to record everything moving forward?
zh: 你能多分享一下关于公司未来需要记录一切的这个论点吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think as LLMs become more capable and as AI agents do more work at companies, I think that's definitely a given.
zh: 我认为随着 LLM 变得更强大、AI 智能体在公司里做更多的工作，这一点肯定是必然的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The context of everything that's going on becomes super important because otherwise your AI agent is working in isolation.
zh: 正在发生的一切的上下文变得极其重要，否则你的 AI 智能体就是在孤立地工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't know what was said earlier today or what a customer said.
zh: 它不知道今天早些时候说了什么，或者客户说了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the opportunity cost of not recording is already pretty high and it's only going to become higher and higher.
zh: 所以不记录的机会成本已经很高了，而且只会越来越高。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as a result, I think more and more companies are going to default to recording everything and default to sharing the context from conversations that can be shared across the company.
zh: 因此，我认为越来越多的公司会默认记录一切，并默认分享那些可以在全公司共享的对话上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also it's something that we think a lot about, not just making it easy to capture everything that happens in conversations, but also giving our customers confidence that
zh: 这也是我们思考很多的事情，不仅是让记录对话中发生的一切变得容易，还要让我们的客户确信

speaker: Unknown
en: The things that are captured will be shared with the right people and nothing will be shared inadvertently so that you feel comfortable using the product for every single one of your conversations without the worry of like, oh, is this thing that I said in this one-on-one going to be shared with the whole company?
zh: 被记录的内容只会分享给合适的人，不会有任何内容被无意中分享出去，这样你就能放心地把产品用于你的每一次对话，而不用担心，比如，我在这次一对一里说的话会被分享给全公司吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So as someone who's building on the frontier, where do you think software engineering is headed?
zh: 那么作为一个在前沿构建产品的人，你认为软件工程正走向何方？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's an incredibly exciting time to be building software because the bounds of what's possible is now more so your imagination, not so much the skills that your team or you have or the bandwidth that you have.
zh: 我认为现在是构建软件令人极其兴奋的时代，因为可能性的边界现在更多取决于你的想象力，而不再是你或你的团队拥有的技能或带宽。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think as the cost of writing software becomes lower and lower, what matters more is not
zh: 我认为随着编写软件的成本越来越低，更重要的不再是

speaker: Unknown
en: How fast you ship, but what you decide to build and how you decide to build it in order to be able to continue composing the systems that you build together and having them interoperate and work together.
zh: 你出货多快，而是你决定构建什么、以及你决定如何构建它，以便能够持续地把构建的系统组合在一起，让它们互相协作、共同运作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that what I'm most excited about that every day is like how the field of software engineering and building software is changing seemingly like every few weeks.
zh: 我认为，我每天最兴奋的事情就是软件工程和构建软件这个领域，看起来每隔几周都在发生变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think it's an awesome time to be a builder, especially at a startup because you get to
zh: 而且我认为现在是一个成为建造者的绝佳时代，尤其是在创业公司，因为你可以

speaker: Unknown
en: Play around with the latest tools and you're not bogged down by the red tape.
zh: 玩最新的工具，而且不会被繁文缛节拖累。
